reviews.text: Dino is the absolute best dog trainer. I’ve seen immediate improvement with my dog in just a few sessions. He completely changed our lives.

After months of dealing with a very picky eater culminating with a three and a half day hunger strike, I reached out to Dino as a final attempt before deciding to surrender my dog.  He responded to my contact form request within five minutes and arranged our first visit for that very same day.  His first reach out to me was a phone call which I appreciated so we could discuss our issues in full before engaging in a meet up.  He was knowledgeable, friendly and my dog ate during our session.  He followed up with several referrals for nutrition and some activities for us to work on here at home.  Highly recommend!

Our dog is a usually good boy who suddenly started becoming reactive, and we had no idea why. He showed immediate improvement from the first meeting with Dino, so we happily signed up for a larger training package. Dino was able to give easy, manageable instructions that seemed too simple to work, but showed fast, noticeable results followed by continued improvements. Our dog loved Dino and all of the training has made him a lot calmer and happier.

Dino cured our two rescues of their reactivity towards other dogs in just a few sessions! We had worked with our other trainers in the past that didn’t help much, but Dino was a miracle worker! He even helped us better understand our blind rescue, teaching us how we should be conditioning her to the world around her. Thank you Dino!!! 🙏🏼

I can honestly say that Dino changed our lives. Before working with him, my dog Freddie was afraid to leave the house. He would bite and jump on me and anyone who came over. The results are night and day and we have seen consistent progress! He listens, goes out for walks and runs, and the bruises from his biting have healed. With all his knowledge and way he can read what Freddie needs, Dino has truly helped me and Freddie have such an improved quality of life together! We are continuing to work with him and I’m excited to further Freddie’s results!

Dino is such a great trainer. We have a young shy chihuahua and she has come so far with him — he really knows how to build confidence in shy dogs. Our girl even went missing for 2 days and we brought her straight back to training and she did amazing. He also makes us feel so confident as owners which makes a huge difference. 5/5, can't recommend him enough!

I did not know you could see results in dog training as quickly as we have with Dino. Came to him with a wild golden doodle who barked and humped and had no impulse control with major separation anxiety- and with in weeks he’s a more relaxed dog who listens and it’s truly changed all of our lives. Dino gets flown to different states to train- I get it now. This is our 3rd dog trainer and I truly can say he’s the best around. Would reccomend to anyone.

Dino trained both our 8 year old Aussie, Red, and our 1 year old mostly Border Collie, Hudson. Very different dogs and Dino was great with both of them. They learned some necessary obedience on and off leash and also in the house. Hudson also enjoyed agility training. If you love your dogs then Dino will be a wonderful trainer for them and for you.

We seriously can’t thank Dino enough! We rescued our husky Lumi when she was about 4, and even years later she still had a lot of challenges like stranger danger, leash reactivity, and big tantrums. Our lives had gotten pretty restricted. We avoided taking her out, didn’t have people over, and basically planned everything around keeping her calm.

After 10 sessions with Dino, she feels like a completely different dog. He didn’t just work with Lumi, he taught us how to show up as better dog parents. Once we understood respect, leadership, and clear communication, everything started to change. Lumi now sits and waits for her food, has way fewer tantrums, and is so much more confident. We can now walk her around Larchmont Village with tons of people and dogs, something we thought would never be possible!

Dino clearly cares so much about what he does. He knows how to get Lumi to respect him while still giving her the love and attention she needs. She even perks up when she hears a motorcycle because she thinks it might be Dino showing up!

We’re so grateful for his patience and consistency. This whole experience has completely changed our relationship with Lumi. Thanks again, Dino!
